NOW LIVE: International archive auctions!

With the MLB World Tour returning to Mexico City on April 25, bid now on a collection that features game-used items from previous London Series, Tokyo Series, Mexico City Series and more! Auction ends on April 14 at 8 p.m. ET.

Classic title game rematch lives up to the hype

Less than a month after Venezuela beat USA in the World Baseball Classic final, Eduardo Rodriguez and Nolan McLean squared off again at Citi Field -- and the result was similar. Meanwhile in the Bronx, the A's pulled off a feat they hadn't accomplished since 1979!

Singles won't just be showing up in the box score at this Minors game

One of many great Minor League promotions in April is the Hartford Yard Goats' "Single Again in the City," featuring "low-key icebreakers to help singles make connections." Maybe you'll meet your soulmate at a Double-A game.

Royals share the glove with every infielder getting a touch

Kansas City went 5-6-4-3 around the diamond for a rare double play the likes of which had not been witnessed since 1995, before any member of the Royals infield was born: "We've been working on that pregame," Bobby Witt Jr. joked.
